autorski-zabieg-hb.name: Hey Beauty Signature Treatment
autorski-zabieg-hb.description: Our exclusive HEY BEAUTY signature facial — a bespoke treatment developed by Hey Beauty specialists. A comprehensive experience tailored to your skin's individual needs.

botox-premium-wlosy.name: Hair Botox Premium
botox-premium-wlosy.description: Up to 80% smoothing and straightening with lasting protection and deep nourishment. This intensive hair treatment restores strength, silkiness, and resilience from within.

dermapen.name: Dermapen 4.0
dermapen.description: Microneedling with the latest generation Dermapen device. Evens skin tone, reduces scarring, and stimulates natural renewal. Available as a standalone treatment or extended with a chemical peel.

diamentowa-keratyna.name: Diamond Keratin
diamentowa-keratyna.description: Keratin hair straightening using the Diamond Keratin method. Eliminates frizz, smooths the hair shaft, and restores structural integrity.

ergolift.name: Ergolift
ergolift.description: Facial endermology using precise mechanical techniques. Sculpts and firms the face, neck, and décolleté.

fala-uderzeniowa.name: STORZ Shockwave Therapy
fala-uderzeniowa.description: STORZ® acoustic shockwave treatment that reduces cellulite, firms the skin, and improves circulation. Delivered as a course of 6 sessions.

farba-brwi.name: Brow Tinting
farba-brwi.description: Professional brow shaping with specialist tint application. Available with full brow architecture or as a simple shape-and-tint service.

henna-pudrowa.name: Powder Henna
henna-pudrowa.description: Professional brow styling with luxurious Moroccan henna. Enhances your natural brow shape with a soft, powdery finish that lasts up to two weeks.

koloryzacja-rzes.name: Lash Tinting
koloryzacja-rzes.description: Specialist lash tint for a more intense gaze — no mascara needed. Results last 3–4 weeks.

komplet-hybrydowy.name: Hybrid Set
komplet-hybrydowy.description: Hybrid manicure and hybrid pedicure in a single appointment — complete care for hands and feet.

konsultacja-kosmetologiczna.name: Skin Consultation
konsultacja-kosmetologiczna.description: A full skin assessment including interview, analysis, and a personalised care plan. Your first consultation is complimentary.

lifting-rzes.name: Lash Lift
lifting-rzes.description: Lash lift with a keratin nourishing treatment, including specialist lash tinting. Naturally curled, defined lashes that last 6–8 weeks.

manicure.name: Hybrid Manicure
manicure.description: Combination manicure with Hard Base hybrid colour. Nail build-up and precision application to the cuticle line. 7-day guarantee.

masaz-kobido.name: Kobido Massage
masaz-kobido.description: A non-surgical facial lift using the Japanese Kobido technique. Redefines the facial contour, firms the skin, and releases deep muscle tension.

oczyszczanie-skory.name: Skin Purifying Treatment
oczyszczanie-skory.description: Our signature cleansing ritual combining cavitation peeling, manual deep-cleansing, and effective hydration. Available in a classic version or enhanced with an algae mask.

odbudowa-molekularna.name: Nashi Molecular Rebuilding
odbudowa-molekularna.description: An advanced Nashi regenerative treatment that works at the molecular level, rebuilding damaged hair fibres from the inside out.

pakiet-rekonstrukcji.name: Reconstruction Package
pakiet-rekonstrukcji.description: Book 3 reconstruction treatments and receive the 4th free. The ideal choice for hair in need of intensive, long-term repair.

pedicure.name: Drill Pedicure
pedicure.description: Comprehensive foot care including machine filing and nail treatment. Available with hybrid polish or as a Premium SPA Pedicure with an exfoliating scrub.

regulacja-brwi.name: Brow Shaping
regulacja-brwi.description: Professional brow shaping with defined arch mapping. Precise styling with thread or tweezers. Available with or without full brow architecture.

rekonstrukcja-wlosow.name: Hair Reconstruction
rekonstrukcja-wlosow.description: Intensive repair and rebuilding treatment based on natural keratin and oil. Restores elasticity, shine, and resistance to damage.

rf-mikroiglowa.name: Microneedling RF Radiofrequency
rf-mikroiglowa.description: A synergistic combination of radiofrequency energy and microneedling. Redefines facial contours, reduces wrinkles, and improves skin firmness.

uzupelnienie-zelowe.name: Gel Infill
uzupelnienie-zelowe.description: Gel infill with hybrid colour application. Available in short, medium, and long nail options.

wlosy.name: Hair — Keratin
wlosy.description: Keratin straightening and regenerating treatments for perfectly smooth, luminous hair lasting up to 5 months. Available exclusively at Hey Beauty Zabłocie.
